* * *
### Product Information
#### Product Benefits
  * LEMONADE MIX: 4 pitcher packets of Crystal Light Zero Sugar Lemonade natural flavor with other natural flavor Powdered Drink Mixes
  * ZERO SUGAR: Choose our lemonade drink mix as a great alternative to juice or soda
  * LEMONADE natural flavor with other natural FLAVOR: Flavor water packets add classic lemonade flavor for a refreshing taste
  * QUICK & EASY: Individual drink packets are simple to prepare—just add to water
  * LOW CALORIE: Crystal Light drink mix has 90% fewer calories than leading beverages* and only 5 calories per serving


* * *
#### Description
Crystal Light Lemonade natural flavor with other natural flavor Drink Mix is a refreshing beverage you can enjoy at any time of day. With zero grams of sugar and only 5 calories per serving, Crystal Light is a sweet alternative to juice and soda and has 90% fewer calories than leading beverages (*Per 12 fl oz beverage, this product 5 calories; leading beverages 100 calories), so you don't have to choose between taste and calories. Low in sodium, our powdered drink mix boosts the great taste of lemonade for a satisfying, low-calorie refreshment. Easy to make, simply empty one powdered lemonade mix into a pitcher with 2 quarts (8 cups) of water, stir, and serve. Each packet provides about 5 servings, enough sugar free drink mix for the whole family to enjoy. Crystal Light Lemonade drink powder is perfect for any group setting, so be sure to have some on hand. One box contains 4 individual pitcher packs that are perfectly pre-portioned for easy mixing without measuring, so you can savor in an instant a glass of zero sugar lemonade any time. For best results, cover prepared beverage and store in the refrigerator. Crystal Light comes in a variety of sizes for all your beverage needs. Packed with flavor, without the sugar.
Serving size: 1/5 Packet (3g)
